blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — A 68-year-old widow was arrested with P7.4 million worth of suspected shabu in Zamboanga City in one of the locality’s biggest drug seizures involving a senior citizen, the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-Region 9 (PDEA-9) said on Sunday. Operatives nabbed alias “Sitti” during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Talon-Talon on Thursday evening, Oct. 29. The operation was conducted at around 6:50 p.m. by the PDEA-9 Special Enforcement Team ZAMBASULTA and the PDEA Zamboanga City Office, with support from the Philippine National Police (PNP) 904th Maneuver Company of the Regional Mobile Force Battalion 9.
